messages:
hana (docs): Quick thread: planning a tiny docs patch about networked HSMs for sealed-site installs. Found gaps: airgap packaging of PKCS11, robust installer logs when HSM is unreachable, and a fallback recommendation for local soft-keystore.
raj (eng-platform): Good call. Suggest: 1) preflight that tests TCP reachability to HSM IP:port, 2) clear log lines with exit codes, 3) a short fallback section that shows how to start SoftHSM for temporary ops.
carmen (security): Agree but emphasise that fallback to SoftHSM must be opt-in and documented with security tradeoffs. Add a short sentence about SLA/rotation differences. No permissive perms advice.
leo (support): If we add numeric exit codes in the installer we can auto-map to KB replies. Proposed mapping in thread: 30=net-unreachable,31=pkcs11-missing,32=perm-denied,33=module-load-fail,34=fallback-used. Support can then give two-line fixes.
hana (docs): I'll add a callout box titled "Networked HSM preflight" with a 4-step checklist and a sample netprobe command `nc -vz 10.0.0.5 1234` and an example installer error: `ERROR 30: HSM unreachable (see onprem/hsm-network)`.
raj (eng-platform): Also include `journalctl -u redwood-installer -o short-iso | grep HSM` example so admins can find lines quickly. And suggest `installer --verify-hsm-tcp 10.0.0.5:1234` as a helper.
carmen (security): Add a one-line note to avoid logging private key identifiers; use generic logs like "HSM init failed: network timeout" to avoid leaking key material paths.
leo (support): I'll draft 3 canned responses: unreachable (check firewall/NAT), missing .so in airgap bundle (verify tar listing), and permission denied (check udev/group). Post them in PR comment when ready.
hana (docs): Plan: small troubleshooting appendix, a short SoftHSM snippet with clear security callout, sample installer exit codes and example log grep. I'll open a WIP PR and ping reviewers.
ci-bot: lint results: md-lint: 1 warning (callout width). Run `./tools/lint-md --fix` before merge.
hana (docs): Thanks all, PR will be up in 30m. Tagging reviewers: @raj, @carmen, @leo. End.
